taxonomy.roads_potholes: Visible damage, obstruction, or defect affecting a road, footpath, curb, or related public surface.
taxonomy.garbage_sanitation: Visible litter, unmanaged waste, overflowing public bins, or sanitation concerns.
taxonomy.drainage_sewage: Visible blocked drains, standing water, sewage overflow, or drainage infrastructure concerns.
taxonomy.water_leakage: Visible leaking pipes, water wastage, or damage to public water infrastructure.
taxonomy.streetlights_electrical: Visible streetlight outage or damage to public electrical infrastructure.
taxonomy.damaged_public_infrastructure: Visible damage to public infrastructure not better represented by another category.
taxonomy.other_uncertain: The issue is outside the configured categories or the available evidence is insufficient to classify it reliably.

routine_localized_issue.description: A localized visible maintenance issue without supported service, access, or potential-safety impact.

service_disruption.description: Visible evidence supports disruption to a public service or normal use of public infrastructure.

public_access_obstructed.description: Visible evidence supports obstruction or material restriction of public access.

potential_safety_hazard.description: Visible evidence suggests a possible public-safety hazard; this is a review flag, not an emergency finding.
